> `missionctl guide launch` as this release renders it, with no installation behind it. Where this file and your server differ, the server is right.

# Author and launch

Four steps, each its own call. The first two commit nothing.

| Step | Call | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Compile | `missionctl mission compile` | Validates the manifest and resolves every `search` entry to an exact pin. Returns the Validation Report and persists nothing. |
| Preflight | `missionctl preflight` | Lists the owner setup, freshness, degradations and readiness this manifest needs before it can spawn. |
| Submit | `missionctl mission submit` | Compiles again, commits the manifest as a revision and admits its run (or its chain). Starts nothing. Send a new UUID as `request_id`; repeating it returns the same identities. |
| Start | `missionctl mission start` | Launches the admitted run: the only step that runs agents and spends budget. It subscribes your coordinator inbox to the run first. |

## A refused compile

A report with `ok: false` is a refusal: the definition cannot be committed, and a submit would refuse it too. Each entry of `blockers` has a `code`, a `pointer` into the manifest, a `message` and often a `reason`. Fix the manifest at the pointer and compile again. The report is evidence; change the manifest, never the report.

| `code` | Means | Do |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `INVALID_DEFINITION` | The shape or a rule is broken; `reason` says which (`widens_authority`: a node widened the budget, governors or side effects it inherits). | Fix the field at `pointer`. Nodes may only narrow. |
| `CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE` | A `search` entry matches no admitted definition, or a pin is not in the catalog, was retired or is not supported on the node's lane. | Search again (topic `capabilities`). |
| `CAPABILITY_DRIFT` | A pin's version or digest does not match the admitted row. | Pin the row the message names. |
| `UNSUPPORTED_BEHAVIOR` | The lane does not run that node's behaviour. | Choose another lane or behaviour (topic `workflows`). |
| `APPLICATION_FORBIDDEN` | `mission.application` is not this server's application. | Write this server's application id. |

For any other code, act on its `message` and `reason`.

`warnings` do not block: show every one to the user before submit. `start_blockers` and `startable: false` name what a start would refuse although the compile is valid. `resolution.resolved` names the exact pin each `search` became and the `search_mode` that answered it: the catalog's own mode, or `definition_scan` where the search index is not built and the published definitions were scanned (a warning says so). Copy a pin into the manifest as `pin` when the user wants it frozen.

## Stop for approval

Submit and start are consequential. Before each, show the user what will be committed or launched (goals, lane, model, budget ceiling, side effects, warnings) and wait for their yes. Start only when the user asked for the start.

After start, keep the `run_id` and the `subscription_id` of `coordinator_inbox` from the receipt, and continue with topic `observe`.
